title: [Interview] Cutting funds for Erasmus+ student scheme would be ‘giving up’ on Europe’s future, says lead MEP Zdrojewski
lede: Students need not fear deep cuts to the Erasmus+ exchange scheme in the next EU budget, despite the frugal winds blowing from member states, says Bogdan Zdrojewski, a Polish MEP who is the EU Parliament's lead negotiator on the programme.
